search.heading: Search
search.members: {count, plural, one {# member matches “{query}” and is not listed while filters are on.} other {# members match “{query}” and are not listed while filters are on.}} <link>Search without filters</link>
search.emptyDescription: Type a word to find matching threads, posts and members, then narrow it down with the filters.
search.filteredDescription: Try a more general term or remove some filters.
search.noResultsDescription: Check the spelling or try a shorter, more general term.
search.results: {count, plural, one {# result} other {# results}} for <term>“{query}”</term>
search.replies: <author></author> in <forum></forum> · <time></time> · {count, plural, one {# reply} other {# replies}}
